name: Fragment Merge and Analysis
description: Merge fragment stores from two pipeline runs, diff competing perspectives, and produce a reconciled knowledge summary. Designed to compare e.g. whisper-base vs whisper-large-v3 transcription runs, or two different object detection models over the same footage.

inputs.name: store_a
inputs.description: Primary fragment store (SQLite .db) — e.g. from a first-pass pipeline run

inputs.name: store_b
inputs.description: Secondary fragment store — e.g. from a second model or a different run

outputs.name: merged-store
outputs.description: All fragments from both stores; conflicts flagged, superseded rows marked

outputs.name: diff-report
outputs.description: Per-kind perspective disagreements with conflict scores

outputs.name: claims-export
outputs.description: All claim-kind fragments from the merged store, ordered by confidence

outputs.name: stats-report
outputs.description: Aggregate stats: total, kinds, perspectives, mean confidence, time span

env.description: Override to point at a custom bonfyre-fragment binary

stages.name: Seed Merged Store
stages.description: Copy all fragments from store_a into the new merged store

stages.name: Merge Store B
stages.description: Merge store_b into merged store; conflict detection runs automatically

stages.name: Diff Perspectives
stages.description: Find overlapping fragments with conflicting perspectives across both stores

stages.name: Export Claims
stages.description: Export all claim fragments from the merged store, sorted by confidence

stages.name: Export Segments
stages.description: Export all transcript segment fragments from the merged store

stages.name: Export Detections
stages.description: Export all object detection fragments from the merged store

stages.name: Store Stats
stages.description: Compute aggregate statistics over the final merged store

notes: s03 (diff) runs against the ORIGINAL stores before merge to surface raw perspective conflicts.
s04/s05/s06 export queries run against the merged store — they reflect conflict resolution.
s07 stats captures the final merged state.
Fragment emission from operators: set BONFYRE_FRAGMENT_STORE=<path.db> before running
BonfyreTranscribe or BonfyreDetectObjects to auto-emit segment/detection fragments.
Collect two such stores (e.g. whisper-base.db and whisper-large.db) then run F1 to compare.
